newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares lower at unofficial close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares lower at unofficial close.

text.p: Nasdaq shares remained weak on Monday despite a flurry of merger activity, particularly affecting MCI Communications Corp.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 1.27 points, or 0.10 percent, at 1220.51 at its unofficial close, while declines led advancing issues by 2287 to 1772 on volume of about 444 million shares. MCI was the most actively traded Nasdaq issue, up 1/2 at 30-3/4 on news of its $20 billion merger agreement with British Telecommunications Plc. British Telecomm was was up 6-1/8 at 61-5/8 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Access Health Inc was up three at 36-1/2 after the company was awarded a contract for personal health management services from the Federal Employee Program mof the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association.
Shares of Grove Bank for savings surged 11-7/8 to 48-7/8 on news the company would be acquired by Citizens Financial Group, the U.S. unit of Royal Bank of Scotland Group Plc.
